sn44.4:1.3: “What now, friend, is the cause and reason why this has not been declared by the Blessed One?”
sn44.4:1.4: “Friend, it is one who does not know and see form as it really is, who does not know and see its origin, its cessation, and the way leading to its cessation, that thinks:
sn44.4:1.5: ‘The Tathagata exists after death,’ or ‘The Tathagata does not exist after death,’ or
sn44.4:1.6: ‘The Tathagata both exists and does not exist after death,’ or
sn44.4:1.7: ‘The Tathagata neither exists nor does not exist after death.’
sn44.4:1.8: It is one who does not know and see feeling as it really is … who does not know and see perception as it really is …
sn44.4:1.9: who does not know and see volitional formations as they really are …
sn44.4:1.11: who does not know and see consciousness as it really is, who does not know and see its origin, its cessation, and the way leading to its cessation, that thinks:
sn44.4:1.14: ‘The Tathagata neither exists nor does not exist after death.’
sn44.4:2.1: “But, friend, one who knows and sees form …
sn44.4:2.6: consciousness as it really is, who knows and sees its origin, its cessation, and the way leading to its cessation, does not think:
sn44.4:2.9: ‘The Tathagata neither exists nor does not exist after death.’
sn44.4:2.10: “This, friend, is the cause and reason why this has not been declared by the Blessed One.”
